newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk troops kill 24 Kurd guerrillas in southeast.
newsitem.headline: Turk troops kill 24 Kurd guerrillas in southeast.

text.p: Turkish security officials said on Friday troops had killed 24 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas in the latest clashes in the mountainous southeast of the country.
The emergency rule governor's office in Diyarbakir said in a statement that the rebels were killed in separate clashes in the provinces of Sirnak, Mardin and Bingol. It gave no military casualties.
More than 20,000 people have died during the 12-year-old armed conflict between the security forces and the PKK, fighting to take control of southeastern Turkey.
